text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: My name is Nishino Flower. Starting today, my trainer and I will be taking on the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I entered Tracen Academy early after skipping some grades. I'm already race-ready, but I still have a lot of growing to do, both physically and mentally. I'm not sure if I'll be able to run well…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: But Trainer is working really hard and doing everything possible for me, so I want to return the favor as well!
